apps.name: Omyaru Browser
apps.subtitle: Privacy browser and bookshelf
apps.localizedDescription: Omyaru iOS Browser with full Android feature parity: profiles, tab groups, private tabs, tab duplication after source, drag auto-scroll, animated tab close, web image preloader, tracker/ad blocker, userscripts (.user.js), live multi-viewport region capture, watermark remover, hierarchical folder tree bookshelf with PDF export, Face ID/PIN app lock, DoH encrypted DNS, and Google Drive / AES-256-GCM encrypted sync.

versions.localizedDescription: v0.2.0: Full Android feature parity (hierarchical bookshelf tree, live scroll-stitch capture, watermark remover, Google Drive & AES-256-GCM sync, image preloader, userscripts, DoH DNS, Face ID app lock).
